findings.title: Missing prompt accepted by API
findings.observed_behavior: HTTP 200 returned with an empty response, done=true and done_reason=load.
findings.expected_behavior: To be defined by the approved API contract.
findings.risk: Requests without meaningful input may be accepted without an explicit validation error.

findings.title: Incorrect Content-Type accepted
findings.observed_behavior: Request with Content-Type text/plain was accepted and generation succeeded.
findings.expected_behavior: To be defined by the approved API contract.
findings.risk: Clients may rely on permissive content-type handling rather than sending the documented media type.

findings.title: Missing model produces model-not-found error
findings.observed_behavior: HTTP 404 returned with error message model '' not found.
findings.expected_behavior: To be defined by the approved API contract.
findings.risk: The response does not clearly distinguish a missing required field from an unknown model.
